messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Can't deploy app
parts:
taskscheduleR is a Windows specific package, and shinyapps.io is a Linux platform.
You should be able to see in your application's logs something like:

[2017-03-11T20:21:14.965427168+0000] Building R package: taskscheduleR (1.0)
/mnt/packages/build /mnt
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
ERROR:  Windows-only package
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/taskscheduleR’

On Saturday, March 11, 2017 at 3:25:04 PM UTC-5, Keith Lott wrote:
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 355912847 failed: Error building image: Error building taskscheduleR (1.0). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

please help!
